title: Plank velocity at B
description: Essential: Correctly states the final velocity of plank AB as v_AB = v_0/4, derived from momentum conservation and the given v_B = v_0/2.

title: Plank length L
description: Essential: Correctly states the length L = 5v_0^2/(16μg), derived from energy loss due to friction on the rough surface.

title: Arc radius R
description: Essential: Correctly states the arc radius R = v_0^2/(64g), derived from momentum and energy conservation for the motion on CD.

title: Momentum conservation at B
description: Important: Applies momentum conservation to the particle-plank system for the motion from initial state to point B.

title: Energy-work principle on AB
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem or energy conservation with friction to relate initial/final kinetic energies to the work done by friction over length L.

title: Momentum conservation for CD
description: Important: Applies momentum conservation to the particle-slider system at the moment the particle reaches point D on the arc.

title: Energy conservation on arc
description: Important: Applies conservation of mechanical energy for the particle-slider system from point D to the highest point C of the arc.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign in momentum equation (e.g., treating velocities as scalars without regard to direction) or misassigns relative velocity signs.

title: Friction work miscalculation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly calculates the work done by friction (e.g., wrong normal force, missing mass factor, or sign error in energy balance).

title: System mass oversight
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect system mass in momentum or kinetic energy expressions (e.g., treating the slider CD as mass m instead of 2m when combined with the particle).
